svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 09 · San Francisco · 06/12 Night Shift Windows (Uncommon)
svg.desc: Late at night the windows stay lit on the hill. Someone is always awake, looking after someone. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
